name: Is it better to finish a basement or build a room addition?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to finish a basement or build a room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finishing an existing basement builds out a space already sheltered by your home's foundation and roof, whereas a ground-level room addition requires pouring a new foundation, exterior framing, roofing, and siding. Basement finishing delivers new living space at a lower cost per square foot and leaves your yard intact. However, basements come with fixed ceiling heights, existing ductwork, and support posts that require thoughtful framing layouts. If your main goal is adding bedrooms, an entertainment area, or a home office without altering your home's exterior footprint, finishing the basement is generally the more economical choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finishing a basement costs less per square foot and preserves yard space, whereas a home addition requires exterior framing, roofing, and a new foundation.
